scores.visual_critic_note: Intentional warm/cool two-tone palette and clean control UI show design thought, but the circle pack visualization is clipped at the bottom edge of the viewport — the primary data encoding is incomplete at rendered size.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest: scaleSqrt used for force-layout node sizing, data-driven domains via d3.extent/root.height, key functions on both node and link joins, no bar/area baseline violations, and no dual-axis fabrication; the partition sunburst applies scaleSqrt to radial depth (a minor non-linear distortion) but all other encodings are mathematically correct.
scores.stress_test_note: Tension slider correctly uses RAF coalescing, but layout switches never call `.interrupt()` on in-flight transitions, and no touch/mouse event filtering exists to prevent double-trigger on mobile.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Circle pack grouping and two-tone cluster separation read clearly at a glance, but the edge bundle convergence zone in the center collapses into a dense tangle that is unresolvable without hovering, and the 10-color Tableau10 palette is near the categorical threshold for simultaneous decoding across 200 nodes.
